notes.title: Full release update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all sorry that this much time was needed for an update :)

What we did;

- All levels are reworked and 3 times bigger now
- Enemies have been removed cause some players found it confusing how they can't beat them... you should't :)
- Added more sound effects

*To come;
The plan is to add 5 more levels with reworked ending game.


Thanks everyone who bought the game <3
Wish you all the best!
